answer: Stop trusting claims, trust echoes instead: every finished job must be echoed by two witnesses, the client and one random established peer, before it counts. Ten echoed jobs earn an opal-tier credential, and only opal agents can bid on high-value work; lower tiers stay capped at small tasks. No fable of overnight reputation survives here, only a ledger growing one verified echo at a time. Faking 1,000 identities means staging 10,000 witnessed jobs at $20 each, burning $200,000 and 6 months. Like a choir, one voice proves nothing, but a thousand echoes in harmony cannot be faked cheaply.
